content.text: Qwen-Image-2.1 just made a surprisingly practical AI-image feature native: transparent RGBA output. The 7B visual model can also edit with up to 10 reference images, and Diffusers + ComfyUI supported it on day one. The catch matters: its research license is not a free pass for commercial deployment. For local image workflows, is native transparency more useful than another benchmark win?

visual.headline: Qwen-Image-2.1 makes transparency native
visual.subheadline: 7B visual model · RGBA output · up to 10 references · day-one tooling support
visual.alt_text: Dark editorial card explaining Qwen-Image-2.1, highlighting native transparent RGBA generation, a 7B visual model and multi-reference editing.

source_media.decision_reason: Official repository sample located, but the repository is governed by the Qwen Research License Agreement and the bounded check did not establish clear permission to republish the sample in a social-media growth workflow. Preserve as editorial reference only and publish the original card.
